let
  dimension = #table(
    type table [Index = Int64.Type, MQHY = text],
    List.Transform(
      {1 .. 19},
      (n) => {
        n,
        if n < 13 then
          "M" & Number.ToText(n, "00")
        else if n < 17 then
          "Q" & Number.ToText(n - 12, "0")
        else if n < 19 then
          "H" & Number.ToText(n - 16, "0")
        else
          "FY"
      }
    )
  )
in
  dimension
